verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships an official `jitsu-cli` documented across multiple doc pages and GitHub, supporting init/deploy of Functions and management of workspace config objects (destinations, streams, connections), aligning with the AI-native agentic CLI story. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on verification of the CLI itself (community evidence only covers general product feedback, not CLI usage) and more detail on full command surface beyond init/deploy.
